race.comment: ROB THE BANK (8) gets the nod after a narrow Naracoorte second where he travelled well, loomed and was beaten only a head. His record at this track adds substance, and he had ARCHDEACON and MAGIC PRINCESS behind him there. MAGIC PRINCESS (14) was well held in the same race after racing keenly, but her Balaklava run prior was sound and her distance record gives her a genuine rebound profile with weight relief. ARCHDEACON (16) is another danger, having posted consecutive thirds, including a long-neck placing at this venue before finishing just under a length from the winner. He doesn't win often, but he's worth some thought here. SANGUE ROSSO (11) arrives with fresh legs on the back of two better efforts. Gets in well with the 2kg claim and is worth including.
